_why: DECLARED DEPENDENCIES. This child may import its own files plus these, and NOTHING else. gitEr/unhitch.sh enforces it in a sterile room where the host tier does not exist. Adding a line here is a DECISION, not a formality: anything starting with $lib, $tinyStore or $mobRoutes, or climbing into the host tier, is a NO.
_channel_why: THE CHANNEL. One door to the host. The child names the channel, never the host tier. A host wires its real implementation in; the wrapper wires a fixture. Anything the channel does not provide comes back null and the child renders nothing rather than crashing. Every $-import outside this prefix is a SECOND DOOR and unhitch.sh reports it. CHANGED IN RAPPER PHASE 1: this used to name $parent/siblings/mapShared/ — a folder SHARED by every child. mapShared is gone; its modules went DOWN into the children that actually used them, so the channel is now a path INSIDE this child and travels with it when the child is lifted.
_companion_why: THE COMPANION. Every `$parent/siblings/getCache_OnlineMap/...` line below is a DECLARED cross-child edge: the wrapper's create script reads this list (companionsOf) and copies getCache_OnlineMap in beside this child at `npm create` time. It is the ONLY source of that copy — an import this list does not name ships alone and dies on an unresolved specifier in the sterile tree (MEASURED 28 Aug 2026: eight files imported OnlineMap, none were declared, `npm create` laid down no companion). getCache_OnlineMap is the shared map home on purpose (one map engine for both Get Cache maps and the where-child); do not copy these modules into this child or into the wrapper.
_retreeved_why: THE HOST SEAM. `$parent/retreeved/...` is the folder EVERY tier fills (the host tier owns it and its sync script fills it on every tier), so these resolve on both tiers by construction. They are dev chrome (vite dev only) and the shared nav — declared here so hitch_test.sh can tell a reviewed seam from a second door.
_app_why: `$app/*` and `svelte/*` are the framework's own — every tier is a SvelteKit app, so they resolve everywhere. `$parent/retreeved/sharedAssets/*` is the canonical shared-asset seam (see fetch/CLAUDE.md — the getcache_DT_bg.webp lesson, 27 Aug 2026).
